jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for the Electrical Auxiliary Systems of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global supply chain Team. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Electrical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes Power Control Center (Electrical/Instrumentation/Controls), Switchboards, Panel Boards, Switchgears, Low Voltage Transformers, Starting Frequency Converter, Static Excitation System, Batteries & Charging Systems, E-houses, Cables, and Bus Ducting.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and final product inspection during Factory Acceptance Test for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification of our electrical components. Create inspection reports and follow up with punch list
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified supplier non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary
* Supplier Performance: Track Supplier performance, create reports and take adequate measures to implement supplier quality improvement- or risk mitigation measures
* Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality tools landscape e.g. to create process transparency or generate performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above
* Knowledge and experience in auditing, with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred
* Familiarity with quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, and RCA
* Understanding of specific component technologies and standards (or equivalents) like NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and UL is an advantage
* Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time and strong communication skills in English

About the Team

Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder of Siemens Energy
* We offer a wide range of options for balancing family and career, such as flexible working time models, childcare facilities at many locations, the option of trial part-time work or a sabbatical
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description:
Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Global investment in industrial plants and infrastructure is being driven by evolving technologies, resilient supply chains, the energy transition and growing demand for critical resources. Munich Re F&C provides tailored insurance solutions for complex international construction projects, including oil, gas, chemicals and petrochemicals, mining and mineral processing, battery and semiconductor manufacturing, and emerging energy technologies such as green hydrogen, carbon capture and eSAF. As part of our Construction team, you will combine engineering expertise with commercial decision-making. We welcome applicants from insurance, industry, project development, EPC contracting and risk engineering. Prior underwriting experience is not essential if you bring relevant technical or contract expertise, sound judgement and a willingness to learn the insurance business.
Your Job

- Assess and underwrite complex international construction and industrial projects in line with Munich Re's strategy, risk appetite and delegated authority.
- Analyse technical, contractual and commercial information, identify key risk drivers and uncertainties, and document the decision process.
- Develop tailored insurance solutions that balance client needs, risk quality and sustainable profitability.
- Identify attractive business opportunities and contribute to profitable growth, portfolio quality, and diversification.
- Build trusted relationships with brokers, insureds and project stakeholders, and represent Munich Re at client meetings, project presentations and market events.
- Participate in or lead site surveys and translate findings into reports.
- Collaborate with colleagues and specialist experts, support the global Munich Re organisation and contribute to underwriting methods, tools and knowledge sharing.

Your Profile

- A university degree in engineering, natural sciences or other relevant technical disciplines, or a recognised insurance qualification with a strong interest in technical risks.
- Professional experience in process-driven industries, equipment manufacturing or another relevant technical environment, or experience in construction project insurance.
- The ability to understand complex industrial processes, project structures, and to derive clear conclusions from complex or incomplete information.
- The ability to familiarize yourself quickly with new topics, work independently, take ownership and make well-reasoned decisions.
- Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, combined with a constructive and solution-oriented approach.
- The ability to analyse technical and contractual documents and the motivation to develop expertise in insurance contracts and policy wordings.
- Curiosity about industrial sectors and emerging technologies, combined with an international and collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across cultures and functions.
- Fluent written and spoken English is required for working in an international business environment. German, Spanish or other relevant language skills are an advantage.
- Willingness to travel internationally.

Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.
About us
As the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.
Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.
Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.
Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.
Unlock your potential

- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.
- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.
- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.

Rewards & Recognition

- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.
- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.
- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.
- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.
- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.
- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.

jobs.occupation: Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Mass Properties department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Mass Properties department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: January 2027
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students (d/f/m) are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our mission

Mass Properties Manching is responsible for defining, calculating, and controlling the mass data set throughout the entire life‑cycle of an aircraft. This data set includes mass, centre of gravity and moment of inertia at component, system and aircraft levels. It is required, for example, for the preliminary design of future projects, structural design, system development, support of flight‑test campaigns, and in‑service support. Consequently, the department maintains interfaces with a variety of disciplines, both within and outside the Flight Physics domain. To keep the growing mass properties data set organised and to trace every change throughout the development of our new projects, we are building a Python‑driven, SQLite‑backed database application. In parallel, we are exploring how AI‑based automation can further increase the efficiency and accuracy of our analyses.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Python Software Development: Develop, maintain, and improve Python-based applications and reusable software components for managing aircraft mass data.
- Database Management: Support the design and implementation of database structures, queries, and data models using relational databases.
- Workflow Automation: Identify and automate repetitive engineering workflows and data-processing tasks to increase efficiency.
- Data Integration & Processing: Develop tools for importing, validating, transforming, and integrating data from various engineering sources and tools.
- AI Research & Prototyping: Investigate and evaluate the application of AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) by developing prototypes for engineering workflows.
- Software Quality Assurance: Ensure software reliability by developing automated/manual test cases, documenting bugs, and improving code maintainability.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Data Science, Informatics, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Good programming skills in Python and a strong interest in software development.
- Basic knowledge or a strong interest in the following areas: SQL and relational databases (e.g., SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL), Software architecture and Object-Oriented Programming, Data processing, automation, and software testing.
- Interest in learning and working with technologies such as: PyQt for GUI development, Git for version control, Jira and Confluence for project management, AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.

In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.
Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.
In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.

Your Tasks

- Organization and coordination of day-to-day laboratory operations, including inventory management, procurement, equipment maintenance, shipping, and logistics
- Coordination of occupational safety, biosafety, and laboratory safety procedures, including support with regulatory documentation and internal inspections
- Organization and quality control of shared consumables, reagents, and laboratory spaces
- Experimental and administrative management of the organoid biobank and bacterial strain collection
- Performance and coordination of key laboratory assays, particularly genotyping and mycoplasma testing
- Onboarding, practical instruction, and supervision of students and new group members
- Communication and coordination with suppliers, service providers, internal DKFZ units, and external collaboration partners

Your Profile

- Very good practical knowledge of biological and/or molecular biology laboratory work and laboratory organization

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about shaping the future of biologics development and driving scientific excellence in analytical and microbiological safety strategies? Join Boehringer Ingelheim's CMC Development Biologicals organization and play a key leadership role within the Quality Control team, where you will influence strategic decisions, engage with regulatory authorities and scientific communities, and advance innovative solutions across our development pipeline. Leading a team of highly ambitious experts, you will help strengthen our microbiological and viral safety capabilities while delivering scientific and regulatory excellence for patients worldwide.
Ready to make a meaningful impact and shape the future of biological medicines? We look forward to receiving your application.
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
This position has a hybrid setup with a minimum of 3 days per week on site.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead your team by providing clear directions, prioritizing tasks and developing strategies.
- Furthermore, you will contribute to the Quality Control Leadership Team by making continuous improvements, strengthening the team's impact across the development value chain, and leading project-related initiatives.
- You will also Initiate and lead innovation projects by identifying strategic needs in the organization
- In addition, you will develop and maintain solid microbial and virus-safety strategies.
- You will actively contribute and influence the scientific and regulatory community by representing Boehringer Ingelheim at conferences and in industry consortia
- Finally, you will shape the microbiology network within Boehringer Ingelheim and ensure seamless interfaces.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in Virology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Biology or Biochemistry, or a related quantitative scientific discipline
- Strong scientific expertise in microbiology and virology, with a proven ability to apply knowledge in a research and development environment
- In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices related to microbiology and virology
- Solid knowledge of Novel Biological Entity (NBE) development principles, processes, and associated requirements
- Passion for innovation and emerging technologies, particularly in the detection, characterization, and monitoring of viruses and microorganisms
- Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities
- Demonstrated leadership experience is a plus
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, supported by a strong professional network

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
